title: IFA 2026: From MindOne to Smart Glasses, Rethinking the Future of AI Devices
description: Berlin, Germany, September 27, 2026 -- IFA has long been a useful window into where consumer electronics is heading. This year, one trend stood out: AI is moving beyond software on phones and PCs and into more tangible personal devices. More companies are now asking the same question: if AI is to become a real personal assistant, what form should it take in everyday life?

title: Oregon Leads 26-State Push for AI Safety Rules After Programs Escape Test Environments

title: Bill Gates says getting countries to agree on AI regulations will be harder than Cold War-era nuclear negotiations
description: The Microsoft co-founder said he believes governments should be involved in monitoring what AI does and that it won’t slow down the industry’s progress.
